title: omp RPC wire protocol
description: Generated by `bun run gen:rpc` from packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire. Commands are JSON lines on stdin; responses and frames are JSON lines on stdout.

commands.name: negotiate_protocol
commands.doc: Switch the connection to a protocol version advertised by `ready`.

commands.name: prompt
commands.doc: Submit a prompt; acknowledged once admitted, completed by its `prompt_result`.

commands.name: steer
commands.doc: Queue a steering message.

commands.name: follow_up
commands.doc: Queue a follow-up message.

commands.name: remove_queued_message
commands.doc: Remove one pending queued message by its queue-chip text.

commands.name: promote_queued_message
commands.doc: Move one queued follow-up to the end of the steering queue.

commands.name: abort
commands.doc: Abort the current run.

commands.name: abort_and_prompt
commands.doc: Abort the current run and submit a prompt; completed by its `prompt_result`.

commands.name: abort_and_restore_queue
commands.doc: Withdraw queued user input, then abort the current run; returns the withdrawn input.

commands.name: new_session
commands.doc: Start a new session.

commands.name: open_session
commands.doc: Continue the newest non-empty session in a directory, or start a fresh one there. Give provider and modelId together to override the saved model; otherwise an unavailable saved model fails the request.

commands.name: get_state
commands.doc: Snapshot the session state.

commands.name: set_fast_mode
commands.doc: Enable or disable fast mode for the session.

commands.name: set_slow_mode
commands.doc: Turn `/slow` on or off for the active model; returns whether it is now on.

commands.name: goal
commands.doc: Read or change goal mode with the lifecycle of the interactive `/goal` command.

commands.name: set_ask_dialog
commands.doc: Opt in to `ask` UI requests; returns the applied setting.

commands.name: get_available_commands
commands.doc: List the slash-command catalog.

commands.name: get_entries
commands.doc: Read the append-history; with `since`, only entries strictly after that durable entry id.

commands.name: get_tree
commands.doc: Read the raw session tree.

commands.name: set_todos
commands.doc: Replace the session's todo phases.

commands.name: set_host_tools
commands.doc: Replace the host-owned tools the server may call back into.

commands.name: set_host_uri_schemes
commands.doc: Replace the host-owned URI schemes.

commands.name: set_subagent_subscription
commands.doc: Select which subagent frames are forwarded.

commands.name: set_event_filter
commands.doc: Forward only the listed session event types; null forwards all.

commands.name: get_subagents
commands.doc: List running subagents.

commands.name: get_subagent_messages
commands.doc: Read a subagent transcript by id or registered session file (`subagentId` wins).

commands.name: cancel_subagent
commands.doc: Hard-kill one running subagent; false when it is not running.

commands.name: steer_subagent
commands.doc: Send a message to a running subagent as its user.

commands.name: live_start
commands.doc: Start a live voice session bound to this session; returns the voice in use.

commands.name: live_stop
commands.doc: Stop the live voice session, if any.

commands.name: live_mute
commands.doc: Set microphone mute, or toggle it when `muted` is omitted; returns the new state.

commands.name: set_model
commands.doc: Select a model by provider and id.

commands.name: cycle_model
commands.doc: Cycle to the next model.

commands.name: get_available_models
commands.doc: List available models.

commands.name: set_thinking_level
commands.doc: Set the thinking level.

commands.name: cycle_thinking_level
commands.doc: Cycle to the next thinking level.

commands.name: get_available_thinking_levels
commands.doc: Selectable thinking levels for the live model, `"off"` first.

commands.name: set_steering_mode
commands.doc: Set how queued steering is delivered.

commands.name: set_follow_up_mode
commands.doc: Set how queued follow-ups are delivered.

commands.name: set_interrupt_mode
commands.doc: Set how steering interrupts tools.

commands.name: compact
commands.doc: Compact the conversation.

commands.name: set_auto_compaction
commands.doc: Enable or disable auto-compaction.

commands.name: set_cache_warming
commands.doc: Override cache warming for this session only; returns the effective mode.

commands.name: set_auto_retry
commands.doc: Enable or disable auto-retry.

commands.name: abort_retry
commands.doc: Abort a pending auto-retry.

commands.name: bash
commands.doc: Run a shell command.

commands.name: abort_bash
commands.doc: Abort the running shell command.

commands.name: get_session_stats
commands.doc: Session statistics.

commands.name: export_html
commands.doc: Export the session as HTML; returns the written path.

commands.name: switch_session
commands.doc: Switch to another session file. Give provider and modelId together to override the saved model; otherwise an unavailable saved model fails the request and keeps the current session.

commands.name: branch
commands.doc: Branch the session at an entry.

commands.name: fork
commands.doc: Fork into a new session file: history through `entryId`, or the whole session.

commands.name: get_branch_messages
commands.doc: List user messages that can be branched from.

commands.name: get_last_assistant_text
commands.doc: Text of the last assistant message, if any.

commands.name: set_session_name
commands.doc: Rename the session.

commands.name: handoff
commands.doc: Hand the conversation off to a fresh session; null when no handoff was produced.

commands.name: get_messages
commands.doc: Every message of the session in one response.

commands.name: get_messages_page
commands.doc: One stable page of messages.

commands.name: get_login_providers
commands.doc: List OAuth providers and their authentication status.

commands.name: login
commands.doc: Run OAuth login; the flow arrives as `open_url` and `input` UI requests.

commands.name: get_logout_accounts
commands.doc: List the stored credentials `logout` can remove for a provider, active first.

commands.name: logout
commands.doc: Remove one stored credential; fails when it is no longer stored. `remainingSource` names auth that still applies.

commands.name: predict_word
commands.doc: Ghost-text suffix for the prose word ending at `cursor` (a UTF-16 offset); null when none applies.

commands.name: predict_word_feedback
commands.doc: Report a shown suggestion as accepted or typed past.

commands.name: btw
commands.doc: Ask a side question, or a follow-up in topic `recordId`; returns the record once it is running.

commands.name: btw_cancel
commands.doc: Cancel the running side question (only topic `recordId` when given); false when none matches.

commands.name: get_btw_history
commands.doc: List the session's side-question records, newest first.

Attribution.description: Who initiated a message, for billing and attribution.

ImageContent.description: Inline image; also the shape hosts send with prompts.

FallbackContent.description: Anthropic server-side fallback boundary marker; consumers other than Anthropic ignore it.

MessageContent.description: Message content: plain text or content blocks.

AssistantMessageEvent.description: Streaming update for one assistant message, discriminated by `type`.

ThinkingLevel.description: Thinking selector; `inherit` defers to a higher-level selector.

ConfiguredThinkingLevel.description: User-configured thinking selector, including automatic selection.

contextWindow.description: Null when the provider does not report a limit.

maxTokens.description: Null when the provider does not report a limit.

ModelInfo.description: Model descriptor: the client-relevant subset of the server's model record.

MessageUpdates.description: `set_event_filter` projection: `delta` drops the accumulated snapshots from `message_update`.

SubagentSubscriptionLevel.description: Forwarded subagent frames: none, lifecycle and progress, or also raw session events.

blocker.description: What a `blocked` task is waiting on.

liveSteered.description: Leading `steering` entries are live steering already sent into the streaming response; `remove_queued_message` cannot reach them.

QueuedMessagesState.description: Displayable queue-chip text for pending user-authored messages; accepted verbatim by `remove_queued_message`.

Goal.description: A tracked goal: its objective, lifecycle status, and resource accounting.

GoalModeState.description: Session goal mode; `mode` is `"exiting"` while a completed goal unwinds.

GoalResult.description: Outcome of every `goal` op; both fields are null when the session has no goal.

SlowModeScope.description: Where `/slow` lives: persisted config shared by every session, or this session's flex tier.

resetsAtSec.description: Epoch seconds when the limit that was hit resets.

allowanceLeftPercent.description: Percent of the low-priority allowance still available, when reported.

UsageLimitLowPriority.description: Requests are served on the provider's low-priority (slow) lane.

extraUsage.description: Whether paid extra usage serves requests once the allowance is spent.

resetsAtSec.description: Epoch seconds when the limit that was hit resets, if reported.

UsageLimitWrapUp.description: Requests run on a short wrap-up allowance past the limit.

UsageLimitState.description: Provider-neutral state of an account past its usage limit, discriminated by `stage`.

slowModeEnabled.description: `/slow` is on for the active model; always `false` when `slowModeSupported` is `false`.

slowModeScope.description: Where the active model's `/slow` lives; absent when unsupported.

usageLimit.description: Usage-limit stage of the active model's account; absent outside wrap-up and low priority.

hasPendingAsyncWork.description: Background jobs or deliveries can still inject a follow-up and wake the session.

isSettled.description: Idle with nothing queued or pending; same predicate as `session_settled`.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt sections, for session dumps.

goal.description: Current goal mode; null when the session has no goal.

OpenSessionResult.description: `open_session` outcome; `resumed` is false when a fresh session was started.

images.description: The removed message's images, so the client can restore them with its text.

imagesDropped.description: Only ever `true`: the images exceeded the transport limit and were omitted; the removal still happened.

RestoredQueuedMessage.description: Queued user content withdrawn from the queue, as the editor would restore it.

imagesDropped.description: Only ever `true`: the full result exceeded the transport limit and every `images` was omitted.

truncated.description: Only ever `true`: even the text-only result exceeded the limit, so only an oldest-first prefix is listed.

AbortAndRestoreQueueResult.description: User-authored queued input withdrawn before the abort, oldest first.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

SessionEntries.description: OMP-native session entries in append order.

nextByte.description: Pass as the next `fromByte` to read incrementally.

reset.description: `fromByte` exceeded the file size and reading restarted at zero.

BtwStatus.description: Side-question turn lifecycle; `interrupted` marks a turn whose process died while it ran.

BtwHistoryTurn.description: One question and its answer within a side-question topic.

BtwHistoryRecord.description: A side-question topic: its first turn's fields plus follow-ups; the latest turn is the last follow-up, else the record.

LogoutAccount.description: A stored credential `logout` can remove; `active` marks credentials the session may be using.

PromptAck.description: `agentInvoked: false` means the prompt completed locally and no `prompt_result` follows.

messages.description: Messages of the run; an oversized frame drops a prefix already delivered by `message_end` (see `messageCount`).

messageCount.description: Original message count when the frame was compacted.

isTerminal.description: False when a continuation or async delivery remains.

yielded.description: The agent finished its turn and resumes only for queued input or background-job results.

awaitingAsyncWork.description: Non-terminal end whose only possible resume is a background-job result.

messageId.description: Shared by the start, updates, and end of one message; unique per process.
Shared by the start, updates, and end of one message; unique per process.
Shared by the start, updates, and end of one message; unique per process.

skipped.description: Compaction was skipped for a benign reason.

retryErrors.description: Persisted retry errors whose presentation changed when the retry settled.

CacheWarmingStartEvent.description: A prompt-cache refresh was handed to the provider.

usage.description: Present only when the refresh was billed.

warmingStopReason.description: Why warming stopped; absent while it continues.

CacheWarmingEndEvent.description: Outcome of the refresh announced by the matching `cache_warming_start`.

configured.description: The user's selector when it differs from the effective level.

resolved.description: The level `auto` resolved to this turn, once classified.

GoalUpdatedEvent.description: Goal mode changed, by a host `goal` command or the agent's `goal` tool.

liveSteered.description: Leading `steering` entries are live steering already sent into the streaming response; `remove_queued_message` cannot reach them.

QueueUpdateEvent.description: Coalesced snapshot of the displayable steering/follow-up queue, sent whenever it changes.

RpcAgentEvent.description: A session event, discriminated by `type`; `set_event_filter` selects which are sent.

ReadyEvent.description: First frame after startup; transport fields are absent on servers without protocol v2.

retryable.description: Transient: resubmitting later may succeed (omp's own retries are exhausted).

sessionSettled.description: Nothing will wake the session again; when false a `session_settled` follows once background work drains.

PromptResultEvent.description: Terminal outcome of one accepted `prompt` / `abort_and_prompt`, keyed by request `id`.

SessionSettledEvent.description: The session went quiet: the last run yielded and no background work can wake it.

AvailableCommandsUpdateEvent.description: Slash-command catalog, pushed at startup and whenever command metadata changes.

detached.description: The subagent runs as a detached background job.

SubagentLifecycleEvent.description: A subagent started or ended; sent at subscription level "progress" or "events".

SubagentProgressEvent.description: Aggregated subagent progress; sent at subscription level "progress" or "events".

SubagentEvent.description: A subagent's own session event; sent only at subscription level "events".

LiveLevelsEvent.description: Microphone (`input`) and speaker (`output`) RMS in [0, 1], at most every 100 ms.

LiveTranscriptEvent.description: Accumulated text of one realtime turn; replaces earlier frames with the same `role` and `turn`.

LiveEndEvent.description: Sent exactly once when a live session ends; `error` carries the failure cause.

BtwDeltaEvent.description: Text appended to the running side question's latest answer.

BtwRecordEvent.description: Full side-question record on every lifecycle change (started, complete, cancelled, error); the last one per id wins.

CommandOutputEvent.description: Output of a builtin slash command.

SessionInfoUpdateEvent.description: A builtin slash command changed the session title.

ConfigUpdateEvent.description: A builtin slash command changed the model configuration.

RpcFrameErrorEvent.description: An event could not fit within the transport limits and was dropped.

recommended.description: Index into `options` of the recommended choice.

AskQuestion.description: One question of an `ask` request; hosts always offer free text besides `options`.

AskUiRequest.description: Every question of one `ask` tool call; sent only after `set_ask_dialog` enables it.

CancelUiRequest.description: Close the dialog opened by request `targetId`; a later answer to it is ignored.

launchUrl.description: Short loopback redirect to `url`; the truncation-safe copy target.

AskAnswer.description: Answer to one `ask` question: exact option labels, plus optional free text.

CancelUiResponse.description: Dismisses a dialog; `timedOut` reports the host's own deadline (an `ask` then takes its recommended answers).

AnswersUiResponse.description: Answers an `ask` request: one `AskAnswer` per question, in question order.

ExtensionUiResponse.description: Host reply to an extension UI request; variants share `type` and differ by their payload key.

HostToolResultPayload.description: Tool output: content blocks plus optional details.

HostToolUpdate.description: Streams partial output of a pending host tool call.

HostToolResult.description: Completes a pending host tool call; `isError` surfaces the content as a tool error.

HostUriResult.description: Completes a pending host URI request.

RpcHostRequest.description: Server request for host-owned tools and URI schemes, discriminated by `type`.

RpcInbound.description: Non-command frame the host sends, discriminated by `type`.

id.description: The command's `id`; absent for failures the server could not correlate.

data.description: Command result on success; its shape is the command's `result`.

code.description: Machine-readable failure reason, when one applies.

RpcResponse.description: Response to a command, correlated by `id`.

RpcNotification.description: Unsolicited outbound frame (everything except responses and host tool/URI requests), discriminated by `type`.

RpcServerFrame.description: Any frame the server writes to stdout (after reassembling `rpc_chunk` sequences), discriminated by `type`.
